name: auto-model-router-mp
description: Single-plugin marketplace for auto-model-router — per-prompt model + effort routing for Claude Code (delegates to a haiku/sonnet/opus worker only when it is cheaper than the session's own model), parallel wave execution for plan-mode and multi-part prompts, and a goal-anchored usage report (cost saved vs the parent model / correction rate / time-to-results).

plugins.name: auto-model-router
plugins.description: Routes prompts to a cheaper model when one will do: a heuristic classifier picks a tier and effort, and when that tier is strictly cheaper than the session's own model the prompt auto-delegates to a router-{haiku|sonnet|opus} worker subagent. Plan-mode and multi-part prompts fan out into parallel waves with disjoint-file safety, and /router-report scores the cost saved against the parent model, correction rate, and time-to-results.
